scope: Before/after review must use each unchanged October 31 native.png and its exact source/frame identity. No historical/new exposure pairing and no invented gap geometry.
all_candidates: obs-NNNN-candidates.json; pure offline extraction of the same image, explicitly not accepted physical returns

after_required_fields.native_png_sha256: Must equal the original PNG byte hash
after_required_fields.source_identity: Must equal source_id, sequence, generation, acquisition_session_id and calibration_id of snapshot.json
after_required_fields.candidate_uv: Own ordered Nx2 native candidate UV array; must not infer/smooth/interpolate missing returns
after_required_fields.retained_indices: Distinct integer indices into candidate_uv, with a documented primary-ray association rule
after_required_fields.rejected_indices: Distinct integer indices with per-candidate rejection reasons
after_required_fields.unresolved_indices: Competing/unclassified native candidates; cannot silently become retained or rejected
after_required_fields.gap: Optional: actual supporting endpoint indices, physical_lip_confidence, inferred_center_not_measured, and uncertainty at least half the unobserved interval. Manual mask edges are not physical cut lips.

manual_review_regions: analysis.json operator_review_regions are manual hypotheses, never automatic ground-truth rejection masks

display.source_pixels: Gamma 0.5 applied to display copy before JPEG encoding; PNG/native detector inputs unchanged
display.after_colors: Retained green; rejected red; unresolved amber
display.gap_rendering: Observed support endpoints plus hatched unobserved interval and explicit conditional uncertainty. Inferred center dashed and labeled not a measured seam.
display.fallback_without_algorithm_output: Show manual review hypotheses in amber and label algorithm decision unavailable; do not claim improvement or automatic rejection.

publication: Primary coordinator publishes only after validation. Diagnostics worker performs no camera/robot operations.
